name: Duplicate driving licence
description: Get a duplicate driving licence when the licence is lost or destroyed, defaced, torn or completely written up, or when its photograph needs replacement.
description_hi: लाइसेंस खो जाने, नष्ट होने, खराब/फटने या पूरा भर जाने पर, या फ़ोटो बदलने की ज़रूरत होने पर डुप्लिकेट ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस प्राप्त करें।
authority: State Transport Department / Licensing Authority (Parivahan Sewa, MoRTH)
verification_notes: From the Parivahan Sewa duplicate licence page (central guidance; State Transport Departments may differ). The listed documents are only needed 'if available', so they are optional. Fees are not modelled. This does not replace getting a first licence.

requirements.name: Original licence (written up or defaced), if available
requirements.name_hi: मूल लाइसेंस (भरा हुआ या खराब), यदि उपलब्ध हो

requirements.name: Attested photocopy of the licence, if available (when lost)
requirements.name_hi: लाइसेंस की सत्यापित फ़ोटोकॉपी, यदि उपलब्ध हो (खोने पर)
